rationale: Withhold. On the 1,540-case frozen set gemini-3.8-flash passes 5 of 10 gates as a full candidate and 4 of 6 as the proposed cohort: macro F1 0.889 against a 0.893 floor and cash withdrawal recall 0.90 against 0.95 still fail. Shadow replay over 14 simulated days shows 85.5% label agreement, $1.65 of model spend, and about $151 more net value for the cohort than the classifier alone (assumption-based). The gain does not justify releasing below the sensitive-recall bar; fix the card payment versus direct debit confusions and re-evaluate.

rationale: Measured on the 1,540-case frozen set, gemini-3.1-flash-lite passes 3 of 10 gates: macro F1 0.839 against a 0.893 floor, five sensitive intents below 0.95 recall, and 0.95 on risk-suite sensitive routing. Even with those intents excluded, the cohort fails macro F1 and risk routing. It is also dominated: gemini-3.8-flash is more accurate and cheaper per call with caching.
